title: Variational Joint Magnetometry and Gradiometry on Dipolar Spin Chains
summary: Estimating a uniform magnetic field B0 and its spatial gradient g on a dipolar-coupled spin chain calls for a multiparameter figure of merit. The GHZ state, optimal for single-parameter Heisenberg-limited sensing, has a rank-one quantum Fisher information matrix with det(Q^GHZ) = 0 at every chain length N, ruling it out for the two-parameter problem. We present a variational framework that takes det(F) as the objective and a hardware-motivated layered dipolar circuit as the ansatz.
